verdict.rationale: The evidence pack holds substantive server-side text captured from the public homepage and /professionnel: navigation labels, FAQ questions, the e-invoicing guide blurb, and even theme-switcher text. That implies the public reading surface returns real HTML content rather than a JS-only shell or a CAPTCHA interstitial. However, no item states how it was fetched (keyless, identified user agent) or documents a bot policy, and deeper guidance and article pages are not shown. missing for 10: confirmation the fetch used a plain identified-UA keyless agent, evidence that deeper guidance and FAQ pages (not just landing pages) are reachable, documented crawler or robots policy, independent corroboration of no bot wall
